record.question: The world's longest and deepest rail tunnel has recently opened in which country?
record.explanation: Answer D: Switzerland. The Gotthard Base Tunnel is in Switzerland. It was ceremonially opened on 1 June 2016 and described as the world's longest and deepest railway tunnel; regular scheduled service began in December 2016. Historical/source note: Historical June 2016 inauguration; scheduled passenger service began 11 December 2016. Reference: https://www.ticino.ch/en/commons/details/The-Gotthard-Base-Tunnel/1219.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
